ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION_PARAGRAPH_1: Hi, I’m Viktor – a passionate programmer with a focus on efficient and elegant solutions. I’m inspired by the way IT offers creative approaches to solving complex problems. I see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow. My motivation comes from a constant drive to improve and explore new technologies. By adopting best practices and embracing continuous learning, I strive to deliver high‑quality solutions in every project.
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION_PARAGRAPH_2: Let's collaborate and build something remarkable together!

SKILLS.DESCRIPTION_TEXT: A short introduction of your skills. Highlight your experience of using different front-end technologies and emphasise your openness to learning and adapting to new technologies.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Projects
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Encourage people to take a look and interact with your projects. Highlight your approach to creating responsive, user-friendly projects with efficient code.

JOIN.TITLE: Join
JOIN.DESCRIPTION: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.

ELPOLLOLOCOGAME.TITLE: El Pollo Loco
ELPOLLOLOCOGAME.DESCRIPTION: A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.

DABUBBLE.TITLE: DaBubble
DABUBBLE.DESCRIPTION: This App is a Slack Clone App. It revolutionizes team communication and collaboration with its intuitive interface, real-time messaging, and robust channel organization.

TESTIMONIAL_1.TEXT: Dear Viktor, there are two keywords that immediately come to mind when I think of you: lightning-fast and harmony! :D You complete tasks in impressively short time with absolute reliability. You maintain calm and harmony at all times, which in my eyes is a real talent. Your helpful and committed nature make you a true pillar of the team, and I appreciate that tremendously. I hope we will continue to work together on more projects in the future!

TESTIMONIAL_2.TEXT: Viktor, working with you on our shared business project JOIN was consistently pleasant and enriching. Your calm and composed nature brings stability to the team, and I find it impressive how you solve problems independently without losing sight of others. You are always helpful, reliable, and a true anchor of calm in the project. I greatly appreciate your dedication and look forward to working together on something again!

TESTIMONIAL_3.TEXT: Viktor's technical expertise and dedication to clean code are impressive. He brings innovative solutions to complex challenges and mentors junior developers effectively.

CONTACT.DESCRIPTION_PARAGRAPH_1: I'm excited to take on challenging projects and put my knowledge of modern web technologies to use. I love working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript. I've also done quite a bit with Angular, Firebase, and REST APIs from small frontend solutions to interfaces that run smoothly.
CONTACT.DESCRIPTION_PARAGRAPH_2: I work well in teams, especially with Git and Scrum, because I like working together step by step toward our goals. So if you're looking for someone who's motivated, enjoys problem solving, and values clean code let's just have a chat!

GENERAL_INFO.TITLE: Collection of General Information When Visiting Our Website
GENERAL_INFO.PURPOSE_CONTENT: When you access our website, i.e., when you do not register or otherwise transmit information, information of a general nature is automatically collected. This information (server log files) includes the type of web browser, the operating system used, the domain name of your Internet service provider, your IP address and similar.

PURPOSES: for the technically error-free display and optimization of the website
GENERAL_INFO.NO_PROFILING: We do not use your data to draw conclusions about your person. However, we reserve the right to subsequently check the server log files should concrete indications point to illegal use.
GENERAL_INFO.LEGAL_BASIS: The processing is carried out in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR on the basis of our legitimate interest in improving the stability and functionality of our website as well as ensuring system security and abuse detection.
GENERAL_INFO.RECIPIENTS: Recipients of the data may be technical service providers who act as processors for the operation and maintenance of our website.
GENERAL_INFO.STORAGE: Data is stored in server log files in a form that enables identification of the affected persons for a maximum of 14 days; unless a security-relevant event occurs (e.g. a DDoS attack).
GENERAL_INFO.STORAGE_EXCEPTION: In the event of such an event, server log files are stored until the security-relevant event is eliminated and fully clarified.
GENERAL_INFO.PROVISION: The provision of the aforementioned personal data is neither legally nor contractually required. However, without the IP address, the service and functionality of our website is not guaranteed. In addition, individual services and services may not be available or restricted.

RIGHT_TO_OBJECT.TITLE: Information about Your Right to Object according to Art. 21 GDPR
RIGHT_TO_OBJECT.INDIVIDUAL_OBJECTION: You have the right to object at any time, for reasons arising from your particular situation, to the processing of personal data concerning you which is carried out on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (data processing on the basis of a balancing of interests); this also applies to profiling based on this provision within the meaning of Art. 4 No. 4 GDPR.

GOOGLE_ANALYTICS.TITLE: Google Analytics
GOOGLE_ANALYTICS.CONTENT: This website uses Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google Inc. ('Google'). Google Analytics uses so-called 'cookies', which are text files placed on your computer, to help the website analyze how users use the site. The information generated by the cookie about your use of the website will be transmitted to and stored by Google on servers in the United States. Google will use this information for the purpose of evaluating your use of the website, compiling reports on website activity for website operators and providing them other services relating to website activity and internet usage. Google may also transfer this information to third parties where required to do so by law, or where such third parties process the information on Google's behalf. Google will not associate your IP address with any other data held by Google. You may refuse the use of cookies by selecting the appropriate settings on your browser, however please note that if you do this you may not be able to use the full functionality of this website. By using this website, you consent to the processing of data about you by Google in the manner and for the purposes set out above.

GOOGLE_ADSENSE.TITLE: Google AdSense
GOOGLE_ADSENSE.CONTENT: This website uses Google AdSense, a service for including advertisements from Google Inc. ('Google'). Google AdSense uses so-called 'cookies', which are text files stored in your computer that enable an analysis of the use of the website by you. Google AdSense also uses so-called web beacons (invisible graphics). Through these web beacons, information such as the visitor traffic on these pages can be evaluated. The information generated by cookies and web beacons about your use of this website and delivery of advertising formats are transmitted to a Google server in the USA and stored there. This information can be passed on from Google to contracting parties of Google. However, Google will not merge your IP-address with other data stored by Google. You can prevent the installation of cookies by setting your browser software accordingly; however, we point out that in this case you may not be able to use all functions of this website to their full extent. By using this website, you declare your consent to the processing of data collected about you by Google in the manner described above and for the purpose specified above.
